Name: Hippie Desert Trader
Author: omena007
Description:
I absolutely love JazzMinK's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3839]Hippy Trailer Home and the cabins[/url] (check them out!) and I wanted to use them somewhere since my character is more of a log cabin person. So this mod was born. The camel seemed a bit strange for the calico desert in the first place so I added a cute snake instead. I'm playing the first time with the new desert trader around and my first thought was that the style seemed kind of out of place? Like some kind of a stereotype of an ~exotic~ trader? So anyway, now he is your hippie friend.

Optional files: desaturated sand, no snake and DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/7886557-1725804964.png[/img]
JazzMinK's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3839]Hippy Trailer Home and the cabins[/url]
The new Desert Festival sprite uses Molenfeuer's wonderful art from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22225?tab=posts]the Peaceful Ant (Paintings of Peace and new Shop)[/url] Mod.
Amazing portrait addition: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414]They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Vendors[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish
[/url]
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/d2d43c832c3088acc48d38ae98dc0717/62014660f4cf50c6-29/s250x400/1690946730141d9579dcbc27b36e6c5d5bf3e203.png[/img]
SH's Wild Critter Tweaks and other mods that edit camel will conflict.
